title.narrative: ICRC operations by the New Delhi (regional) Delegation(2024 Unaudited)

description.narrative: The ICRC is an independent and non-political organisation with a large scope of activities which it undertakes through its presence in most countries. Its existence and activities are universally recognised and it regularly responds to the needs of people adversely affected by situations of humanitarian concern, in particular armed conflict and violence. We usually work in partnership with National Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies of India, Nepal, Bhutan and the Maldives. In Nepal, the ICRC addresses the consequences of the internal conflict that ended in 2006 and helps people affected by unrest. We help the Nepal Red Cross, government and other bodies to boost their emergency capacities, and we promote IHL. We carry out most of our work with the National Society.
